items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: we had Ray Michaels playing drums

ctx.x: Yeah, it was the same band, with you know, a few minor changes. We had a different drummer, and there had been a couple of changes, one change in the trumpet section and one in the saxophone section, oh, and one in the trombone section. We had gotten Lyle, "Spud" Murphy, for the first trombone, which we needed badly, because none of the

guys we had in the Famous Door was really a first trombone player and Spud was. And we had strengthened the trumpet section by adding Johnnie Owens, and we had Ray Michaels playing drums, rather than Wes Dean, who was in the Famous Door band. But basically it was the same band, and they'd been together a long time, you know as bands go.
Did Spud Murphy write for your band then?
